description: Foreign-born 2016-17 Dodgers signees outside the amateur rule that a researcher classified with a source. Used by scripts/research/sources/intl-list-corroboration.mjs with --tx and --people-dir.

source.title: Dodgers reported Fernandez deal will be ~$200k, shouldn't impact Dozier talks
source.notes: "Cuban infielder Jose Miguel Fernandez is nearing a Minor League deal with the Dodgers, sources told MLB.com's Jesse Sanchez ... Per Sanchez, Fernandez's signing bonus is worth around $200,000." An approximate figure: not imported as a bonus.

entries.name: Jose Miguel Fernandez
entries.classification_note: Age 28 at signing; reported to have played seven Serie Nacional seasons for Matanzas; a minor-league deal reported as outside the international bonus pools (Baseball America, not read directly: the site refuses automated requests). Bonus reported as about $200,000 (MLB.com via Dodgers Digest) and left unknown as an exact figure.
